title: salix viminalis var. pubera
intro: Salix viminalis var. pubera, commonly known as the wild or European willow, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Salicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, as well as treating fever and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Salix viminalis var. pubera include salicin, salicylic acid, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have shown antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, making it a subject of interest in modern pharmacological research.
